Information to collect: County and state, parcel IDs, address or coordinates, and a map of the land on offer.
Useful evidence: Assessor, deed, and dated boundary survey.

Information to collect: Owner or authorized representative, sale or lease preference, and what can be included.
Useful evidence: Title documents, option rights, and authorization.

Information to collect: Gross acres and largest connected buildable area. Show space for the substation, access, drainage, and setbacks.
Useful evidence: Survey, civil concept, and known easements or environmental constraints.

Check: Land use, road access, and approvals
Information to collect: Current zoning, status of the proposed use, legal road access and any pending applications.
Useful evidence: Local land-use records, written planning response and recorded access documents.

Information to collect: Serving utility, requested MW and phase dates, document stage, point of delivery, and open conditions.
Useful evidence: Dated response, load study, or signed service agreement for this site.

Information to collect: Named carrier, route and site handoff options. Record what is nearby or in service.
Useful evidence: Written carrier response, route or construction estimate.

Information to collect: Water and wastewater providers, measured or planned demand, pressure and discharge details where relevant.
Useful evidence: Provider service letters. For a well or spring, document yield, withdrawal rights and discharge separately.

Information to collect: Asking terms, option dates, parties authorized to share documents, and due diligence milestones.
Useful evidence: Draft or signed term sheet, approval and disclosure records.
